_meta.description: Authority asset backlog and publishing workflow for VOA-specific tools, assessments, planners, worksheets, journals, glossaries, protocol libraries, timers, and downloadable resources.

experienceSchema.description: Optional `experience` object on any published interactive asset (planner/ritual/assessment, not a static reference/glossary). Every field is optional; add what genuinely applies. Purely descriptive metadata for editorial planning and future automation ~ not read by any generator yet, but keep it accurate so it can be.

fields.category: Short kind label, e.g. ritual, assessment, planner, timer
fields.primaryPurpose: One sentence: what problem this actually solves for the reader
fields.emotionalOutcome: The feeling it should leave someone with
fields.practicalOutcome: The concrete thing they walk away with
fields.estimatedMinutes: Realistic completion time as a string or number
fields.artifactType: The signature saveable/printable payoff this experience produces, if any
fields.printable: true/false ~ does it have a working print button
fields.neighboringExperiences: Array of other asset slugs a reader of this one would plausibly want next
fields.recommendedFollowUp: Single asset slug for the one best next step, if one exists yet

assets.title: Digital Attention Audit
assets.description: A reflection tool for noticing where digital inputs are draining focus, self-trust, and creative energy. Not a clinical assessment.
assets.clinicalDisclaimer: This is an educational reflection tool, not a medical, psychological, or diagnostic instrument.

experience.primaryPurpose: Help a reader notice which digital inputs are draining their focus and self-trust.
experience.emotionalOutcome: Clarity without shame ~ a named pattern instead of vague self-criticism.
experience.practicalOutcome: One concrete action and one deeper practice to try this week.
experience.replayValue: medium ~ worth retaking after a few weeks of real change

assets.title: ADHD Focus Session Planner
assets.description: A ritual for starting deep work when your attention is scattered ~ five small decisions, one breath, a real focus session, and a personal Focus Card at the end.
assets.clinicalDisclaimer: This is a reflective ritual, not a medical or clinical tool. It does not diagnose ADHD or any other condition.

experience.primaryPurpose: Turn the decision paralysis before deep work into a five-step ritual that ends in actually starting.
experience.emotionalOutcome: Permission and momentum ~ the work already got broken into a size that feels doable.
experience.practicalOutcome: A real timed focus session plus one tiny commitment to open with.

experience.replayValue: high ~ designed to be used every real working session

assets.title: Nervous System Reset
assets.description: A short grounding ritual that turns five small decisions into a personalized reset sequence and a Reset Mandala built from your own answers.

experience.artifactType: Presence Rings (concentric, varying thickness/spacing) + Presence Card
experience.replayValue: high ~ designed for repeated, varied use
